_README: Default MC Trade Import Profiles column set used by dryrun.py when no --template is given. MemberClicks does not publish the template header row (it is downloaded inside MC Trade: Admin > Import Profiles > Download Template Here). H1 says the import refuses columns that are not in the template and that deleting template columns other than unused AffCode/CustomField columns 'could cause errors'. So: every output file uses ONE fixed column set, in this order, with unused columns left blank. Day one: run with --template <GAC's downloaded template.xlsx>; the script then copies that header row exactly and fills only the columns it recognises (via 'individual'/'organization' below). status: DOCUMENTED = exact header text appears in MemberClicks help; API-FIELD = documented API field name, not proven as an import header; UNVERIFIED = inferred.

template_columns.source: H2: updates must 'Include Profile ID and a corresponding name (OrganizationName or LastName)'; exact spelling not shown
H1: 'the regular Email column would be for an organization'
H1 'Ind' prefix rule + D5 LastName; H2 'LastName'

H1 names the MemberSince date; H2: on updates use 1/1/1900
H1: 'Category must be an exact match'
